", "data:image/webp;base64,"].map(src=>{let im=new Image();im.src=src;return im;});
function resize(){
 cssW=innerWidth;cssH=innerHeight;
 const dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,mobile.matches?1:1.4);
 const gpuScale=mobile.matches?.72:.91;
 canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(cssW*dpr*gpuScale));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(cssH*dpr*gpuScale));
 marks.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(cssW*dpr));marks.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(cssH*dpr));
 if(drawgl && gl)gl.viewport(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
 if(mq.matches)render(performance.now());
}
function scrollProgress(){
 const h=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-innerHeight;
 return clamp((scrollY||pageYOffset||0)/Math.max(1,h),0,1);
}
function pointForProgress(time){
 let side=clamp(cssW/1200,.45,1);
 let cx=.5+(sample(stops.x,p)-.5)*side;
 let cy=sample(stops.y,p);
 let dur=1900,elapsed=clamp((time-loadedAt)/dur,0,1);
 let entrance=Math.pow(1-elapsed,3)*(-.26);
 return {x:cx,y:cy+entrance,r:sample(stops.r,p)*(mobile.matches?.77:1),rot:1.36+time*.000035+p*PI*1.6};
}
const PI=Math.PI;
function drawMarkers(time,scene){
 if(!ctx)return;
 const dpr=marks.width/cssW;
 ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,cssW,cssH);
 if(mq.matches||mobile.matches)return;
 const {x,y,r,rot}=scene;
 const c=Math.cos(-rot),s=Math.sin(-rot),ct=Math.cos(-.37),st=Math.sin(-.37);
 cities.forEach(([latitude,longitude],i)=>{
 const la=latitude*rad,lo=longitude*rad;
 const a=Math.cos(la)*Math.cos(lo),b=Math.sin(la),z=Math.cos(la)*Math.sin(lo);
 const rx=c*a+s*z,rz=-s*a+c*z;
 const px=ct*rx-st*b,py=st*rx+ct*b;
 if(rz<.23)return;
 let sx=x*cssW+px*r*cssH,sy=(1-y)*cssH-py*r*cssH;
 if(sx<0||sx>cssW||sy<0||sy>cssH)return;
 let alpha=Math.min(.78,(rz-.2)*1.1),pulse=(time/2300+i*.139)%1;
 ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,193,7,${alpha*(1-pulse)*.53})`;
 ctx.lineWidth=1;
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,3+pulse*15,0,PI*2);ctx.stroke();
 ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(255,207,105,${alpha})`;
 ctx.shadowColor='#ffc107';ctx.shadowBlur=9;
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,1.7,0,PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.shadowBlur=0;
 });
}
function drawFallback(time,scene){
 if(!fallback)return;
 let w=canvas.width,h=canvas.height,sx=w/cssW;
 let cx=scene.x*w,cy=(1-scene.y)*h;
 const radPx=scene.r*cssH*sx;
 fallback.fillStyle='#05070c';fallback.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
 // Fixed cinematic space gradient, twinkling stars, and the atmospheric halo.
 let nebula=fallback.createRadialGradient(w*.79,h*.72,0,w*.79,h*.72,h*.85);
 nebula.addColorStop(0,'rgba(23,67,139,.32)');nebula.addColorStop(1,'rgba(5,7,12,0)');
 fallback.fillStyle=nebula;fallback.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
 for(let i=0;i<520;i++){
  const px=((i*87211.33)%1013)/1013*w;
  const py=((i*76217.71)%1051)/1051*h;
  let tw=.4+.34*Math.sin(time*.0007+i);
  fallback.fillStyle='rgba(153,183,233,'+tw.toFixed(3)+')';
  fallback.fillRect(px,py,i%11===0?1.5:1,i%11===0?1.5:1);
 }
 let glow=fallback.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,radPx*.75,cx,cy,radPx*1.43);
 glow.addColorStop(0,'rgba(38,113,243,.12)');
 glow.addColorStop(.55,'rgba(24,85,217,.34)');
 glow.addColorStop(1,'rgba(3,8,25,0)');
 fallback.fillStyle=glow;fallback.beginPath();fallback.arc(cx,cy,radPx*1.43,0,PI*2);fallback.fill();
 const count=globeFrames.length;
 let f=(((scene.rot-1.36)/(2*PI))%1+1)%1*count;
 let i0=Math.floor(f),i1=(i0+1)%count,blend=f-i0;
 if(globeFrames[i0]?.complete&&globeFrames[i0].naturalWidth){
  fallback.globalAlpha=1-blend;
  fallback.drawImage(globeFrames[i0],cx-radPx,cy-radPx,radPx*2,radPx*2);
  if(globeFrames[i1]?.complete&&globeFrames[i1].naturalWidth){
   fallback.globalAlpha=blend;
   fallback.drawImage(globeFrames[i1],cx-radPx,cy-radPx,radPx*2,radPx*2);
  }
  fallback.globalAlpha=1;
 } else {
  let earth=fallback.createRadialGradient(cx-radPx*.38,cy-radPx*.33,0,cx,cy,radPx);
  earth.addColorStop(0,'#416ca2');earth.addColorStop(.5,'#0d3b72');earth.addColorStop(1,'#05102a');
  fallback.fillStyle=earth;fallback.beginPath();fallback.arc(cx,cy,radPx,0,PI*2);fallback.fill();
 }
}
function render(time){
 if(document.hidden)return;
 let now=scrollProgress();target=now;
 p+= (target-p)*Math.min(1,(mobile.matches?.25:.16));
 const scene=pointForProgress(time);
 if(gl){
 gl.useProgram(prog);
 gl.uniform2f(u.res,canvas.width,canvas.height);
 gl.uniform2f(u.center,scene.x,scene.y);
 gl.uniform1f(u.radius,scene.r);
 gl.uniform1f(u.time,time*.001);
 gl.uniform1f(u.rotation,scene.rot);
 gl.uniform1f(u.progress,p);
 gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP,0,4);
 }else drawFallback(time,scene);
 drawMarkers(time,scene);
}
function frame(time){
 if(!running)return;
 requestAnimationFrame(frame);
 const rate=mobile.matches?1000/24:1000/35;
 if(time-lastFrame<rate)return;
 lastFrame=time;render(time);
}
window.addEventListener('resize',resize,{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{target=scrollProgress();if(mq.matches)render(performance.now());},{passive:true});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(!document.hidden&&mq.matches)render(performance.now());});
resize();
if(!mq.matches){running=true;requestAnimationFrame(frame);}else render(performance.now());
window.ccCosmos={get status(){return {gpu:!!gl,textureLoaded:webglReady,scroll:p,reducedMotion:mq.matches};}};
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
